strings: Elder Moonwarden is an honored ancestral spirit visited during the Lunar Festival, standing under a celestial beam of light at the Crossroads in the Barrens. Speaking with him offers travelers ancient wisdom and guidance toward other elders scattered throughout the continent.
A Celestial Presence in the Barrens

Standing amidst the dusty thoroughfare of the Crossroads, Elder Moonwarden appears bathed in a radiant column of heavenly light. He represents the ancient spirits revered during the Lunar Festival, a time when mortals pause their conflicts to pay homage to the wisdom of past generations.

Elder Moonwarden muses on the starry heavens and their ability to reveal earthly mysteries to those who look up in search of truth. In addition to bestowing his own ancestral blessings, he offers seekers direction toward fellow elders across Kalimdor, including Elder Bloodhoof, Elder High Mountain, Elder Morningdew, and Elder Runetotem.

Elder Bladeswift is an ancestral spirit honored during the Lunar Festival within the night elven capital of Darnassus. Located in the Cenarion Enclave, this ancient figure offers travelers wisdom drawn from the starry heavens above. Seeking his blessing connects adventurers directly to the revered traditions of the Cenarion Circle and the night elven people.

During the Lunar Festival, the spirits of revered ancestors manifest across Azeroth to share their wisdom and bestow blessings upon travelers. Bladeswift the Elder stands amidst the serene boughs of the Cenarion Enclave in Darnassus. Unlike modern residents preoccupied with the trials of the present, this spectral forebear looks upward to the cosmos, contemplating the mysteries woven into the night sky.

Night elven culture has long revered the celestial bodies as reflections of Elune and the deeper secrets of existence. Bladeswift reminds those who approach him that the countless stars hold answers to worldly struggles, urging the wise and fortunate to gaze upward. By acknowledging his presence, adventurers receive a Coin of Ancestry and take part in a timeless ceremony bridging the mortal realm with the spirits of the past.

Following evidence of targeted raids on Horde supply lines, Thork commands the execution of Kreenig Snarlsnout, the Razormane quilboar warband leader orchestrating caravan attacks from Durotar. By breaking their defensive line and claiming Kreenig's tusk, the Horde aims to throw the aggressive tribe into disarray.

The vital trade route running between Durotar and the Crossroads has suffered continuous ambushes, threatening the flow of provisions and reinforcements across the northern Barrens. Scout reports pinpointed the culprit: an aggressive Razormane quilboar raiding party organized and directed by a chieftain named Kreenig Snarlsnout. Recognizing that scattered skirmishes would never permanently secure the road, Thork ordered a direct decapitation strike against the leader to break the tribe's tactical cohesion.

Kreenig entrenched his war party in the craggy hills northeast of the Crossroads, shielded by hardy Razormane Defenders and geomancers who manipulate the arid earth. Eliminating his guard and striking down Snarlsnout in his own redoubt was intended to send a harsh message across the plains. Claiming Kreenig's severed tusk served as undeniable proof that the Horde would brook no predation upon its lifelines.

Soft Saber Pelts represents a trade agreement aimed at keeping wilderness roads secure from predatory cats. Hunters bring in the thick furs of local sabers so they can be crafted into warm, protective blankets and shawls.

Traversing the untamed paths of Azeroth requires constant vigilance against prowling predators. Large sabers frequently roam near well-traveled thoroughfares, presenting a persistent hazard to couriers, merchants, and lone adventurers. While local inhabitants admire the grace and majesty of these great cats, allowing their numbers to swell unchecked along trade routes invites deadly ambushes. Gathering hunters to keep the local roads safe serves as a necessary measure for communal survival.

Hunting such impressive beasts is not done merely for sport or eradication. In frontier encampments, every resource is valued, and the dense, velvety coats of wild sabers are prized for their warmth and durability. Once brought in by capable hunters, the pelts are tailored into fine shawls and heavy blankets capable of fending off harsh weather, ensuring that nothing taken from the wild goes to waste.

Isha Awak is a sacred rite of the hunt issued by the mystic Mahren Skyseer along the Merchant Coast. Brave Horde wanderers are charged with diving into the Great Sea to track down and slay a fearsome aquatic predator known as the Deep Doom. By claiming the beast's heart, the hunter partakes in an ancient bond of spirit and respect.

Off the coast south of Ratchet, lurking beneath the waves, roams Isha Awak. Known as the Deep Doom, this immense sea creature commands the coastal waters with formidable strength and predatory solemnity. The human encroachers encamped along the shoreline have learned to dread the waters, having lost many of their scouts and soldiers to the creature's relentless hunger.

Unlike the terrified humans ashore, Mahren Skyseer holds deep reverence for the leviathan. To the tauren mystic, Isha Awak is not a curse or simple pest, but a gift: a worthy and honorable foe whose might tests the resolve of true hunters. Slaying the beast is not merely about culling a predator; it is an act of spiritual communion, claiming the heart wherein the beast's essence dwells and carrying its untamed spirit forward.

Harpy Lieutenants is a Horde quest directed by Darsok Swiftdagger at the Crossroads. Continuing the military campaign against the Witchwing coven in the northern Barrens, champions are sent into the Dry Hills to assassinate the flock's front-line officers and shatter their chain of command.

Following initial clashes against common Witchwing raiders, Darsok Swiftdagger escalates the offensive against the harpies roosting in the Dry Hills. Rather than continuing to thin the rank and file, Darsok tasks Horde scouts with targeting the Witchwing Slayers serving as lieutenants. These officers maintain discipline among the lower flock and coordinate raids against Horde supply paths, making their elimination critical to securing the northern approaches of the Barrens.

Because Witchwing Slayers lead their kin through brutal strength and dominance, only the most vicious among them carry the ornate rings denoting authority within their matriarchy. Taking these rings serves as proof of death, breaking the tactical coordination of the roost and sending a direct, ruthless message to the coven that attacks on Horde territory will be met with decisive retribution.

Executing these officers leaves the lower flock in disarray, but it serves a broader strategic purpose. Stripping the Witchwing roost of its field commanders weakens the perimeter around the heights of the Dry Hills, laying bare the inner sanctum of their matriarch, Serena Bloodfeather.
